prompt: Create a polished anime-style illustration of two young adult women collaboratively composing music in a cute pastel bedroom. The scene is warm, intimate, and wholesome, with soft morning sunlight streaming from a large window on the left through pink curtains. The room has pink walls, a white bed with a pink plaid blanket and a large teddy bear on the right, a vanity mirror and small shelves in the back, scattered framed photos, and music-note decorations on the wall. Both women kneel on a fluffy pink carpet around a low round pale-pink table covered with songwriting materials. Show exactly two characters: on the left, Otobi, a slim curvy young woman with long dark brown hair in a high side ponytail, soft brown eyes, wearing a light blue lace-trim camisole dress with tiny floral or dot pattern, holding a pink mechanical pencil and looking thoughtfully at her friend; on the right, Airi, a curvy young woman with shoulder-length chestnut brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a fitted white V-neck T-shirt with a tiny pink bow motif and pale pink cargo pants, holding a black pen while gesturing with her other hand as if explaining a melody idea. On the table include exactly eight visible item groups: 1) an open spiral notebook filled with handwritten musical staff notation, 2) loose sheets of staff paper with notes, 3) a blue notebook open to handwritten lyrics or music notes, 4) a pink pen lying diagonally, 5) a smartphone in a pink case, 6) a glass of iced tea, 7) a pink mesh pencil cup filled with pens and pencils, and 8) a small stack of three pastel books or notebooks. Add a partial electronic keyboard visible at the bottom left edge and a few loose music sheets on the floor. Use detailed soft-shaded anime rendering, delicate facial features, glossy hair, gentle blush, pastel pink color palette, cozy bedroom clutter, shallow depth of field, high detail, cinematic composition, no text overlays, no watermark, no extra characters.
